'''Quinten Post''' (born 21 March 2000) is a Dutch [[college basketball]] player who plays for the [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College Eagles]] of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). Standing at 7 ft 0 in (2.13 m), he plays as forward and [[Center (basketball)|center]].

He also plays in the [[Netherlands men's national basketball team|Netherlands national team]] since making his debut in 2022.

== Early career ==
Born in [[Amsterdam]], Post played in the junior teams of [[Apollo Amsterdam]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Quinten Post - Men's Basketball |url=https://bceagles.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/quinten-post/14916 |access-date=2022-08-08 |website=Boston College Athletics |language=en}}</ref> He won the national under-18 championship in 2018 as the starting center. He attended the  Cartesius Lyceum.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Quinten Post College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/quinten-post-1.html |access-date=2022-08-08 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}}</ref>

== College career ==
In 2019, Post committed to [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]]. He transferred to the [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College Eagles]] for his junior year in the 2021–22 season.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Flannery |first=Curtis |date=2021-05-05 |title=Mississippi State's Quinten Post announces his transfer to Boston College |url=https://www.bcinterruption.com/2021/5/5/22421957/mississippi-state-bulldogs-quinten-post-transfer-portal-boston-college-eagles-recruit-prospects |access-date=2022-08-08 |website=BC Interruption |language=en}}</ref> In his final season he was named Second Team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] as well as the ACC All-Defensive Team.<ref>{{cite web |title=Quinten Post Earns a Pair of All-ACC Honors |url=https://bceagles.com/news/2024/3/11/mens-basketball-quinten-post-earns-a-pair-of-all-acc-honors.aspx |website=[[Boston College Eagles]] |access-date=March 21, 2024 |date=March 11, 2024}}</ref>

== National team career ==
Post was selected for the preliminary roster of the [[Netherlands men's national basketball team|Netherlands senior team]] ahead of [[EuroBasket 2022]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Voorlopige selectie richting EuroBasket bekendgemaakt |url=https://www.basketball.nl/basketball/nieuws/actueel/voorlopige-selectie-oefencampagne-richting-eurobasket-bekendgemaakt/ |access-date=2022-08-08 |website=Basketball.nl |language=nl}}</ref>
